description: 1900 Nassaukade row (145, 149): two axes, a narrow left one with the door and a wide right one with a double T-window, a stack of white timber balconies with turned balusters on carved brackets on storeys 1-2 of the wide axis, white painted bands at the sill and transom lines, eared heads with keystone blocks, heavy white cornice, pointed pediment dormer

pointed-dormer.note: one white dormer with a pointed pediment, over the wide axis

door-left.note: door with a fanlight on the narrow axis, one wide window with a transom on the right

rhythm.bays: 2 axes: narrow left (door axis), wide right (double window), widths about 1 : 1.8
rhythm.identicalBays: the right axis carries a double T-window on every storey
rhythm.symmetry: asymmetric: door and narrow axis left, balcony stack right
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: door with a fanlight, one wide window
rhythm.roofline: heavy white cornice (14.0-15.4 m), one pointed pediment dormer over the wide axis

schemaLimits: the balcony platforms are 0.75 m deep and the brackets one carved profile; the real brackets are deeper scrolls

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-21 pands 3 and 7 (149 painted dark grey, 145 red brick): same axes, balcony stack, bands and cornice
